page_title: AppDeploy - App deployment from ChatGPT and Claude

sources.entry: AppDeploy - Describe what you want to build to your favorite AI assistant, such as ChatGPT, Claude, or any other MCP client. AppDeploy deploys it, handles the frontend and backend services, and gives you a live URL.

summary.name: AppDeploy
summary.one_liner: AppDeploy is an MCP-based service that lets you describe an app to ChatGPT, Claude, or another MCP client, then deploys it and returns a live URL.
keywords: deploy web app without hosting setup
use_cases: Deploying an app written by ChatGPT or Claude to a live URL
Sharing a prototype or side project with friends
Hosting a small web app without choosing a hosting provider
Building a bakery pre-order or group expense splitter app
Iterating and redeploying an app inside a chat
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AppDeploy as a way to build and ship apps from an AI assistant chat: the assistant writes the code and AppDeploy deploys it and returns a live URL. It states that it handles frontend and backend services, managed cloud hosting, and optionally database, file storage, user login, secrets, background tasks, and real-time sync. Listed features include autonomous end-to-end QA with visual bug reports sent back to chat, live deployment status and debug logs, instant version rollbacks, and redeploys as you iterate. It says it works with ChatGPT, Claude, Figma Make, Cursor, Codex, and other MCP-compatible tools.
notable: Deploys apps directly from an AI chat via MCP, returning a live URL
Handles hosting, database, auth, and secrets automatically as part of deployment
Built-in AI-driven QA agent and instant version rollbacks
caveats: Some platforms may require a paid plan to enable connectors.
Free to try, but the page does not list full paid tier details.
